description: Readiness review for future L5 Runtime Default Injection implementation. Reviews code surfaces, recommends Surface B (task prompt preamble) as Phase 1, marks Surface C (global default system prompt) NOT recommended as first step, and lists safety gates, stop conditions, and future slice proposals. No code changes. No runtime writes. No IPC. No default system prompt mutation. No Agent subprocess.

recommended_surface.name: Surface B — task_prompt_preamble
rationale: Surface A already covered by L4 (Slice 007K/007L/007M); no L5 work needed for A
Surface B narrower than C: only Hermes-dispatched tasks receive preamble
Surface C mutates global default system prompt; high blast radius, pollutes non-Hermes tasks
Surface B is reversible per slice: misbehave → remove preamble step; C is not

not_recommended_surface.name: Surface C — default system prompt fragment
rationale: High blast radius: affects ALL tasks the agent handles, including non-Hermes-dispatched
Not slice-reversible: requires revert of system prompt change; rollback more complex than B
008A § 7 explicit: not recommended as first step; revisit only after B stable in production
Touches locked files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Hermes default prompt) which are explicitly frozen

safety_gates: no_runtime_write (4 literal false flags: runtime_flush_allowed / runtime_dispatch_allowed / real_handoff_write_allowed / live_adapter_allowed)
no_ipc (no ipcMain / ipcRenderer / window.hermesAPI.* in 008F helper)
no_gateway (no serve / run / agent / delegate / playbook / cron in 008F helper)
no_ingest_search (no knowledgeIngest( / knowledgeSearch( / fetch( call expression in 008F helper output)
no_agent_subprocess_in_tests (no spawn / child_process / runPlaybook in 008F test)
no_default_system_prompt_mutation (no write to CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / Hermes default prompt / system prompt fragment)
no_dispatch_builder_mutation (no write to src/main dispatch prompt builder path; new file only)
no_deceptive_copy (no 已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm in preamble)
no_obsidian_memory_wolf_path (no positive recommendation in preamble; 007I mentions allowed as 'do not')
no_bucket_semantics_drift (007I bucket rules preserved in preamble)
stop_conditions: discovers need to mutate default system prompt (e.g. CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / Hermes default)
discovers need for IPC / gateway wiring (ipcMain / ipcRenderer / window.hermesAPI.* in dispatch path)
discovers need for live handoff writer to ~/.hermes/handoff/packs or ~/.hermes/audit
ordinary code-only task gets snippet injected (skip_reason should be 'no_trigger_fired')
feature flag default != false (must stay false until 008F+ explicit user approval)
hermes self-call gets default injection (must stay reserved skip unless explicit override)
base task prompt is overwritten (must be preserved verbatim, only preamble prepended)
runtime flags can be forged to true (008C assertNoRuntime must reject)
forbidden copy appears in simulated preamble (no 已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm)
mtime changes on ~/.hermes/handoff/packs or ~/.hermes/audit (real write detected)
knowledgeIngest / knowledgeSearch / fetch( appears as call expression in 008F output
executable_steps / verificationCommands / next_actions call-form action appears in payload
